text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: General consensus among the media and public is that Seiun Sky is considered to be Special Week's sole rival in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, I have come to a realization: King Halo's true proficiency leans toward sprinting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Faced with concerns over whether it was the right decision to run in the long-distance Kikuka Sho, King Halo nods silently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to be recognized as a first-rate Umamusume, she must shine in the Classic Triple Crown tour. Her face tells me that there's no other option.
